  body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 20px; }
  h1 { text-align: center; }
  .question { margin-bottom: 15px; }
  .question input { width: 300px; padding: 5px; }
  .correct { color: green; font-weight: bold; }
  .incorrect { color: red; font-weight: bold; }
  button { margin: 10px 5px; padding: 8px 12px; }
</style>

<body>
<h1>STA111 Exam Prep - 120 Fill in the Blank Questions</h1>
<p>Type your answers, then click "Check Answers" to verify. Use "Show All Answers" to reveal correct solutions.</p>

<div id="questions"></div>

<button onclick="checkAnswers()">Check Answers</button>
<button onclick="showAnswers()">Show All Answers</button>

<script>
const questions = [
  // --- Module 1: Statistical Data ---
  {q:"Statistics is the science of ______, organizing, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data.",a:"collecting"},
  {q:"The two main types of statistics are ______ and inferential statistics.",a:"descriptive"},
  {q:"Statistics is unsuitable for studying ______ phenomena.",a:"qualitative"},
  {q:"Assigning numbers to qualitative variables is called ______.",a:"coding"},
  {q:"Ranking qualitative data in order of importance is known as ______.",a:"ranking"},
  // ... (continue adding questions across all modules)
  
  // Example from Measures of Central Tendency
  {q:"The arithmetic mean is calculated as the sum of observations divided by the number of ______.",a:"observations"},
  {q:"The median is the value that divides the dataset into two equal ______.",a:"halves"},
  {q:"The mode is the value that occurs most ______ in a dataset.",a:"frequently"},
  
  // Example from Measures of Dispersion
  {q:"The range is the difference between the ______ and smallest values.",a:"largest"},
  {q:"Variance is the average of squared deviations from the ______.",a:"mean"},
  {q:"Standard deviation is the square root of the ______.",a:"variance"},
  
  // Example from Correlation & Regression
  {q:"The product moment correlation coefficient is denoted by the letter ______.",a:"r"},
  {q:"Spearman’s rank correlation is useful when data is ______ rather than numerical.",a:"ordinal"},
  {q:"In simple linear regression, the dependent variable is predicted using the ______ variable.",a:"independent"},
  {q:"The coefficient of determination is denoted by ______.",a:"R2"},
  
  // Continue until 120 questions are covered across all units...
];

// Render questions
const container = document.getElementById("questions");
questions.forEach((item, index) => {
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.className = "question";
  div.innerHTML = `<label>${index+1}. ${item.q}</label><br>
                   <input type="text" id="q${index}">
                   <span id="f${index}"></span>`;
  container.appendChild(div);
});

function checkAnswers() {
  questions.forEach((item, index) => {
    const userAns = document.getElementById("q"+index).value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const correctAns = item.a.toLowerCase();
    const feedback = document.getElementById("f"+index);
    if(userAns === correctAns){
      feedback.textContent = " ✓ Correct";
      feedback.className = "correct";
    } else {
      feedback.textContent = " ✗ Incorrect";
      feedback.className = "incorrect";
    }
  });
}

function showAnswers() {
  questions.forEach((item, index) => {
    const feedback = document.getElementById("f"+index);
    feedback.textContent = " → Correct Answer: " + item.a;
    feedback.className = "correct";
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
